# DhanFunded

> DhanFunded (dhanfunded.com) is an Indian prop trading evaluation platform. Traders take a simulated evaluation on NIFTY, BANKNIFTY and SENSEX index options, with fees, limits and payouts in Indian rupees (INR).

- Three programmes: 2-Step Evaluation (fee from ₹3,000, 80% profit share), 1-Step Evaluation (from ₹3,800, 80%) and Instant Funding (from ₹4,900, no evaluation phase, 70%).
- Account sizes run from ₹1 Lakh to ₹25 Lakh, depending on the programme.
- Options can be bought or sold. Trading is intraday only: positions are squared off by 3:15 PM IST, and futures, overnight positions, copy execution and algo execution are not permitted.
- Shared rules: at most 2% loss on a single trade, at least 5 trading days, and no more than 40% of the target from one day.
- Once funded, payouts run on a 14-day cycle and need at least 5% profit. KYC (PAN, Aadhaar and a bank account in the trader's own name) is required before the first payout, which is paid in INR to an Indian bank account.
- DhanFunded is not a stock broker, exchange, investment adviser or portfolio manager. All trading happens in a simulated environment; no live orders are placed on NSE, BSE or any other exchange.
- Support: support@dhanfunded.com
